edits.old: RWB-ITG-E3013-CON; builds against contract version v1 of the readiness contract RWB-S2-E3013-CON, the published version every consumer pins
edits.new: RWB-S2-E3013-CON (readiness contract); builds against contract version v1, the published version every consumer pins

edits.old: The task due date takes its timer from that answer; until a parameter is named, the platform one-hop default of 2 s applies.
edits.new: The task due date follows the R-SET-22 clock stated in the header; the platform one-hop default of 2 s (DP-13) is the budget of the call that returns the check answer and is not a task timer.

edits.old:
Then the check runs before negotiation starts and a deed in lieu is not negotiated on an asset that cannot transfer
    And the case, the decision record and the task each match the rule and version recorded for their move
edits.new:
Then the check runs before negotiation starts, not at transfer, and a deed in lieu is not negotiated on an asset that cannot transfer
    And on R-DIL-01 the case moves to EARLY_READINESS_CHECK
    And on R-SET-22 a task re-creates the title set before release and the case stays at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED
    And the collateral, title and non-performing asset facts are read through the ACE views and never re-keyed
    And no action proceeds if its decision record cannot be written
    And the case, the decision record and the task each match the rule and version recorded for their move

findings.issue: Contract dependencies names RWB-ITG-E3013-CON, which is not a story of the set.
Item is 'Contract published: Fail'. Publication is still open under the CON story, and GAP-2675 says contract v1 does not yet exist.
The 2 s one-hop call budget was applied as the task due-date timer. This conflicts with the R-SET-22 working-day clock in the header.
AC4 claims every section 8 rule but does not assert BR2, BR3, BR4, BR6 or the 'not at transfer' part of BR8.
The 'Covered by' column omits TC-E3-013-07-ITG (AC4), although that row says it asserts BR1 to BR8.
Note says section 15 already marked the states, but this edit added them. The missing states belong to Screen Specifications v1.
Note says six test cases are in section 16, but there are now nine.
